newsitem.title: UK: UK leading shares climb, breaking key 4,000 level.
newsitem.headline: UK leading shares climb, breaking key 4,000 level.

text.p: Leading British shares cut through the 4,000 points barrier on Wednesday with Wall Street's overnight advance fuelling the London market's push to its new high, traders said.
Shortly after the opening, the FTSE 100 index was trading at 4,009.4, a gain of 17.2 points on the day and well ahead of its previous best of 3,994.1 set on September 20.

An influx of cash at the start of the new quarter and continuing moderate growth and benign inflationary pressures in the UK and U.S. economies have provided the backdrop for the London market's rise in recent days.
